items.brief: U.S. banking associations plan BankChain Alliance for 2027 launch
items.why: Network aims to enable stablecoins, payments, and tokenized deposits within regulated banking system.

items.brief: POSCO tokenizes trade receivables on Avalanche blockchain
items.why: Major company tokenizes real-world business assets, demonstrating RWA adoption at scale.

items.brief: Bitwise launches self-custodied tokenized stock portfolios
items.why: Automated rebalancing of tokenized equities expands onchain asset management capabilities.

items.brief: LayerZero unveils trading infrastructure for tokenized markets
items.why: Infrastructure supports crypto and tokenized asset trading with institutional backing.

items.brief: Bitwise creates AI-themed tokenized stock portfolios via Coinbase
items.why: Tokenized equities enable new automated investment strategies onchain.

items.brief: Bitwise launches themed tokenized stock portfolios on Coinbase
items.why: Tokenized stocks powered by Coinbase enable thematic onchain portfolio construction.

items.brief: Arcus tokenizes perpetual positions on Robinhood Chain
items.why: Transferable ERC-20 tokens for derivatives enable new tokenized trading mechanics.

items.brief: India pilots tokenized corporate bonds using wholesale CBDC
items.why: Government-backed tokenized debt issuance demonstrates RWA adoption in traditional finance.

items.brief: Standard Chartered distributes HKD stablecoin, plans tokenized MMF settlements
items.why: Major bank integrates stablecoin with tokenized money market fund settlement infrastructure.

items.brief: Franklin Templeton and HashKey roll out tokenized money fund in Asia
items.why: Tokenized treasury and money market funds are fastest-growing RWA segment.
